note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official list as carried by PSNProfiles and Exophase, who agree on all 55. Guides are original words written for this entry; every guide names its sources. Missable flags are read from the official descriptions only — see the roadmap's watchlist for the reasoning.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then strangers, collectibles and activities — and this pops the moment the 54th trophy lands. Keep the checklist ticked as you go so you always know exactly what is left.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — finish it and the trophy pops.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies pop at the end of the chapter, so push the story forward and this lands on its own — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it pops when the chapter ends — keep playing the story in order and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The chapter trophy pops at the chapter's end, so the only requirement is completing the story up to that point.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter of the story. It pops at the chapter's end and leaves only the final mission between you and the gold story trophy.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It comes after Chapters 1–4 and the named story missions, and the gold pops when the mission ends. This trophy closes Stage 1 of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list. Story missions unlock in order, so keep playing the story and take the mission when it is offered — the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist when it appears. Heist missions are story beats, so play the story in order and the mission — and this trophy — will come to you.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears. Like the other named-mission trophies, it pops the moment the mission ends — no extra objective is needed.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners when it appears. Keep the story moving and take the mission when it is offered; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

Rockstar Games — Grand Theft Auto VI (rockstargames.com/VI)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears. VCIA is the Vice City airport, so expect this mission to take you there — finish it and the trophy pops.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears. It is one of the named story missions, so play the story in order and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game stats screen tracks what counts — story, stranger strands, collectibles and activities — so clear every other trophy first with this tracker, then mop up whatever the stats screen still shows as undone. This is normally the last trophy before the platinum.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts build up across normal play — jumps, airtime and near misses while driving — so drive hard between missions and let the count climb. The PlayStation counter tracks your total, so check it in the trophy list if you want to know how close you are.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. The trophy list itself names most of them — shooting ranges, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and meditation — so sample one of each and the trophy pops. You do not need to win or master any of them, just try them.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Treat each challenge as its own drill: learn what it scores, then run it until the gold threshold clears. Work through them range by range and tick the count off as you go — 42 golds is a grind, not a trick.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough, so visit each spot, learn its course on a practice run, then race to win. Tick locations off as you win them so none gets missed.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race counts once, so keep entering new events instead of replaying one you have already won. Mix race types as you find them across Leonida.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so keep entering them and out-fish Cal in a single challenge — losing one costs nothing but the attempt, so retry until you beat him.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade cabinet, play it through to its end and the trophy pops. It is one of the quickest activity trophies in the list.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands build mission by mission, so keep returning to Andy's missions when they appear until the strand ends — the trophy pops at the final one.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Follow Kenton's missions to the end of his strand — the trophy pops at the final mission, like the other stranger finals.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Keep taking Billy's missions when they appear until the strand ends — the trophy pops at the final one.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear around the map as you explore, so take every strand you meet and see each one through to its end. Eight finished strands pops the trophy — the individual finals for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each carry their own trophy too.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Follow Randy's missions to the end of his strand — the trophy pops at the final mission.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Keep taking Tyrone's missions when they appear until the strand ends — the trophy pops at the final one.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are found by exploring, so work through the map area by area and meditate at each one you find. Tick them off in the tracker as you go — 18 is a lot to hold in your head.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is part of a stranger strand, so follow Bret's missions until the hunt is offered, then take the animal down. The trophy is about the one unique animal, not general hunting.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you explore and hunt down the missing cards for three full sets. Pick the sets with the fewest cards missing first.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are spread across the whole state, so this is a long exploration trophy — hit the spots as you pass them during other stages and mop up the rest with a dedicated sweep at the end. The counter runs to 100.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small side goals, so they pile up as you play — check the challenges menu often and chase the easy ones first. Fifty is a long grind, so start early and let it build.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Do it away from tight streets so you have room to run.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, rob each in turn, and keep the heat on the whole run — losing the wanted level between shops breaks the chain, so keep moving and do not stop to fight.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count when you first find and use them, so drive everything you see — parked cars, bikes, boats and anything else with an engine. The counter runs to 100 across the whole map.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a tight group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends. Crowded shootouts are the place to try it — if you fall short, the next fight is another chance.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: The description names a single place and a single kind of exit — set it up deliberately instead of hoping it happens.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. This is a stunt at one airport with one way out — get a fast vehicle or aircraft onto the runway and leave the airport on your own terms instead of through the terminal.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy is about tangling with them — expect it during high-heat chaos when tanks roll in. Survive the encounter and the trophy pops.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: One detection ruins the attempt — plan the route in and out before you start.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt is over — leave and try again.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are the big robberies, so plan each one and its getaway, then escape clean — five clean vault escapes pops the trophy.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and get away clean. Trucks run routes across the map, so keep an eye out while driving.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Areas count as you set foot in them, so sweep the map region by region — the coast, the city, the swamps and the small towns. Use the in-game map to spot the gaps you have not visited.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang has its own operations, so hit one per gang — nine gangs, nine robberies. Learn which territory belongs to which gang before you start.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — no chase, no timer, just the beach.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: The description points at one kind of place and one dramatic exit — choose your showroom and escape route before you start the smash.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, get a vehicle inside or through the front, and break out through the glass. Do it in one clean run — the trophy is about the exit, not the mess afterwards.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to that alley, bowl a game, and follow through on your throws. Any finished game at that alley counts.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The description names no repeatable checklist — treat it as tied to a specific partnership moment and do not rush past duo scenes.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one pops from a partnership moment that draws a crowd — keep playing the duo's story and side content together and watch for the moment the crowd gathers.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices lock in as you make them — you cannot un-choose later in the same run, so take the choices the game offers instead of skipping past them.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks this one to a count of 500, so keep making choices — story choices, dialogue choices, side choices — and the count climbs across the whole playthrough.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: The wording points at a second attempt — succeeding first time may never trigger it.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This trophy's own wording points at a second attempt — fail something once, then succeed on the retry. If an attempt goes wrong, retry it instead of reloading an old save.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A one-off strange event is easy to walk past and never see again — explore off the beaten path.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange is out there in Leonida — a weird encounter, a strange sight, an event that does not fit. Keep exploring off the beaten path and the moment will find you.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the moving vehicle. Line the pass up on a quiet street so you can aim the swing.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, and your contacts wash them for clean cash — keep laundering after every big score until the total hits $250,000.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Shops add up fast — clothes, food, gear and everything else — so spend normally through the playthrough and the total will climb. It counts across all shops, not one.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress, so buy each one when it appears and keep the money aside for them. Eight owned garages pops the trophy.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register them — ten registered vehicles pops the trophy.
sources: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
